Vendored, unmodified, so the UI works offline (embedded into the binary):

- `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`: [@xterm/xterm](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js) 5.5.0, MIT (see `LICENSE-xterm.txt`)
- `addon-fit.js`: [@xterm/addon-fit](https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-fit) 0.10.0, MIT (see `LICENSE-addon-fit.txt`)

To update: download the files from jsdelivr (`npm/@xterm/xterm@<version>/lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`, `npm/@xterm/addon-fit@<version>/lib/addon-fit.js`).
